extracted.name: Parmesan Chicken
instruction_lines: Marinara sauce
In a medium pot over medium heat oil.
Add onion and garlic, stir to combine and reduce heat to low
Cover and cook stirring occasionally for 10 minutes
Uncover and cook stirring occasionally until onion is translucent softened and fragrant, aboit 5 minutes
Stir in tomates and basil.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat ti medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally until slightly thickened and flavors have melded, about 30 minutes
Season with salt and pepper. Discard basil
Optional: Add Parmesan rid in the sauce. Remove before serving.
Chicken
In a shallow bowl combine panko, garlic powder and 1 c Paramesan
In another shallow bowl pour flour
In a third shallow bowl beat eggs with 1 T water
Pat chicken dry season with salt and pepper
Dip into flour shaking off excess, then into egg, then into panko mixture, gently pressing to adhere
In a small bowl, mix mozzarella and remaining 1 c Parmesan
Heat broiler
In a large heavy pot over medium heat, heat the oil until a deep-fry or instant read thermometer registrrs 350°
Fry chicken until one side is golden brown. Flip and continueto fry until golden brown on the other side
Repeat for remaing chicken
Place the fried chicken on a foil lined cookie sheet
Spoon some marinara over rhe chicken
Sprinkle the cheese mixture
Broil until cheese is melted and brown. About 2 minutes
Top with basil
